title: Clebsch structure and exact stochastic refinements for monochromatic K_4
current_formal_scope: The source-identical Lean replay checks all 51 modules and 35 selected declarations: 12 use standard kernel axioms and 23 inherit native-evaluation dependencies; none uses admitted or unknown axioms. The standard-only group includes ValidTemplate.countSubgraphs_numerator. The fixed-data assertions retain native compiler/evaluator trust, and the accompanying runtime audit has a documented observation limitation rather than a complete continuous image trace. Pinned sources, separate integer recounts and the exact axiom audit are supplied in the companion repository.
